import asyncio
from typing import Any
from fastmcp import Server, ClientSession
from fastmcp.server.stdio import stdio_server


async def main():
    # Create an in-memory FastMCP server
    server = Server("example-server")

    # Add a resource to the server
    @server.resource("data://config")
    async def get_config() -> str:
        return '{"setting1": "value1", "setting2": "value2"}'

    # Create an in-memory client session connected to the server
    async with ClientSession(server) as client:
        # Fetch the resource at URI "data://config"
        resource = await client.read_resource("data://config")
        print(f"Resource contents: {resource}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())
